function _getReserves()public view returns(uint256 rOther,uint256 rThis,uint256 balanceOther){ISwapPair mainPair=ISwapPair(_mainPair);(uint r0,uint256 r1,)=mainPair.getReserves();address tokenOther=WETH;if(tokenOther<address(this)){rOther=r0;rThis=r1;}else{rOther=r1;rThis=r0;}balanceOther=IERC20(tokenOther).balanceOf(_mainPair);}

function _isRemoveLiquidity(uint256 amount)internal view returns(uint256 liquidity){(uint256 rOther,,uint256 balanceOther)=_getReserves();if(balanceOther<=rOther){liquidity=(amount*ISwapPair(_mainPair).totalSupply())/(balanceOf(_mainPair)-amount);}}
